the_precedent_conflict_this_lane_will_no.the_question: Does this archive hold the Prescription Trails walking guides? There are 34 of them here.
the_precedent_conflict_this_lane_will_no.why_it_is_not_mine_to_answer: Because the inventory already answers it twice, in opposite directions, for documents of exactly the same class.

the_exclusion.recorded_reason: One-page Prescription Trails walking-guide/map for Bianchetti Park, not a durable City plan, study, ordinance, or project record.

the_publication.recorded_description: Maps a 0.6-mile accessible concrete walking route at Manzano Mesa Park, with route directions, accessibility grade, nearby transit, parking and facilities.

the_precedent_conflict_this_lane_will_no.they_are_the_same_kind_of_document: Both are one-page Prescription Trails guides for a single City park, from the same programme, at the same path.
the_precedent_conflict_this_lane_will_no.a_third_thing_worth_knowing: The published one carries no r2_url. Its validation_status reads R2 archival follow-up pending explicit approval. So the record that sets the precedent for publishing is itself not site-ready under the standing rule.
the_precedent_conflict_this_lane_will_no.what_this_lane_recommends: Decide the class once. If the guides are in scope, the Bianchetti exclusion should be revisited and all 34 of these approved together; if they are not, Manzano Mesa should come down. Either way it is one decision, not 34, and this artifact is arranged so it can be applied as one.
the_precedent_conflict_this_lane_will_no.the_general_point: A lane that finds the archive contradicting itself should surface the contradiction, not pick the side that makes its own numbers look better. Approving 34 records here would have been the larger-looking result and the wrong one.

the_first_cross_inventory_byte_collision.what_was_found: final-albuquerque-comprehensive-on-street-bicycle-plan is byte-identical to src-0f60535452ac9154, the 2000 Albuquerque Comprehensive On-Street Bicycle Plan, which is validated and carries an r2_url. Same 8,054,496 bytes, same SHA-256.
the_first_cross_inventory_byte_collision.why_it_was_not_caught_earlier: The two inventory records carry different URL strings for the same object, so a URL group-by finds nothing. Only comparing the fetched checksum against the archived record's own checksum finds it.
the_first_cross_inventory_byte_collision.why_it_matters_beyond_this_record: Every slice in this run has reported zero cross-inventory byte collisions. That was true each time, but it was also a weaker claim than it sounded: most inventory records carry no checksum at all, so the comparison could only ever be made against the 1,612 that do. This one was in that set.

two_files_that_are_not_what_their_names_.the_bike_map: recreation/bike/documents/bike-map.pdf is byte-identical to recreation/documents/2009bikemap.pdf. The City serves its 2009 bicycle map under a name carrying no year. Publishing it as the bike map would present a seventeen-year-old map as current, so the dated name is recommended canonical.
two_files_that_are_not_what_their_names_.the_flag_football_waiver: recreation/documents/waiver-of-liability-flag-football.pdf is byte-identical to additions-to-original-roster.pdf, and its content is the roster form: it opens City of Albuquerque Parks and Recreation Additions to Original Roster. The flag football waiver the filename promises is not at that address. Both files are excluded on the same non-durable ground, so neither is recorded as a duplicate of the other.
two_files_that_are_not_what_their_names_.and_an_extension: recreation/documents/parentscodeofconduct2016.doc has leading bytes 25504446. It is a PDF.
two_files_that_are_not_what_their_names_.the_running_count: Ten filenames across this run now contradict the document or the bytes behind them.

the_mprab_agenda.what_it_is: The Metropolitan Parks and Recreation Advisory Board agenda for 4 May 2021, the only record of that board in the inventory apart from a press notice.
the_mprab_agenda.the_policy_applied: An agenda may be preserved only after a recorded exhaustive official-source review finds no approved minutes, and never for a cancelled or no-quorum meeting.
the_mprab_agenda.the_review: Three candidate official page URLs probed, all HTTP 404. The City's own site search for the exact phrase together with minutes returns No results with no link to the board. The inventory holds no minutes for the board. The agenda carries no cancellation, postponement or no-quorum language.
the_mprab_agenda.the_decision: The exception applies. Recommended for addition, labelled Agenda (approved minutes not located).
the_mprab_agenda.a_caution_carried_on_the_row: It prints a Zoom meeting identifier and passcode. Stale, but strip or redact rather than republish a working-looking credential.

method: Fetched all 97 candidates and measured byte length, SHA-256 and leading bytes from the fetched bytes. Grouped by checksum within the slice and compared every checksum against the 1,612 checksummed inventory records, which is how the archived bicycle plan was found. Read the recreation documents to see what each actually is rather than what its filename claims. Searched the inventory for the archive's own prior decisions on the Prescription Trails class before deciding any of the fifty. Performed and recorded an exhaustive official-source review for the advisory board's minutes before applying the missing-minutes exception to its agenda.

already_archived_check.rule_applied: Test candidates against R2 objects the archive already holds, against the published site, and against anything recommended earlier in the same batch.
already_archived_check.result: One candidate is byte-identical to a record already validated and archived and is recommended duplicate against it.

duplicate_and_supersession_checks.why: Three byte-identical pairs are recorded on their rows rather than as duplicate recommendations, for the same reason in each case: a canonical has to be a record worth keeping, and in these three it is not - or not yet. additions-to-original-roster.pdf and waiver-of-liability-flag-football.pdf are both excluded.
